title: DevOps Engineer
description:
##### **Job Description**

  

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer who will be responsible for designing, implementing, and monitoring the infrastructure; also, to collaborate with other team members to develop automation strategies and deployment processes. You will become an integral part of the team, making every problem of the platform a problem of your own, and solving them accordingly.  



  

##### **Responsibilities**

  

* Help tune performance and ensure high availability of infrastructure
* Design and develop infrastructure monitoring and reporting tools
* Develop and maintain configuration management solutions
* Develop test automation frameworks in collaboration with rest of the team
Create tools to help teams make the most out of the available infrastructure  
* 
  

##### **Skills \& Qualifications**

  

* Experience with Linux servers in virtualized environments
* Strong background in Linux/Unix Administration
* Familiarity with the fundamentals of Linux scripting languages
* Experience installing, configuring, and maintaining services such as Apache, MySQL, nginx, etc.
* Strong grasp on configuration management tools
* Familiarity with load balancing, firewalls, etc.
* Proficient with network tools such as iptables, Linux IPVS, HAProxy, etc.
* Ability to build and monitor services on production servers
* Familiarity with cloud message APIs and push notifications
* Knowledge of servers and switches
* Ability to use a wide variety of open source technologies and cloud services (experience with AWS is required)
* Strong experience with My SQL
* Strong Experience with NoSQL such as MongoDB and Redis
* Strong Experience with Version Control System such as Git
* Strong Experience with Continuous Deployment tool like Jenkins
* Strong Experience with load balancing tool like HAProxy and Niginx
* A working understanding of code and script (PHP)
* Knowledge of best practices and IT operations in an always\-up, always\-available service

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Position: DevOps Engineer  
**Experience:** 3\+ years

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application build, test, and deployment.
* Manage and provision cloud infrastructure on Azure and AWS using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible).
* Set up and manage containerization and orchestration environments using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Monitor system performance, availability, and security using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or CloudWatch/Azure Monitor.
* Automate deployment, scaling, and configuration management processes.
* Manage version control systems (Git) and branching/release strategies.
* Implement and maintain logging, alerting, and incident response processes.
* Ensure system reliability, security, and disaster recovery through backups and failover strategies.
* Leverage AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, etc.) to streamline scripting, troubleshooting, and documentation.
* Collaborate with development teams to streamline build and release processes.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure, deployment, and production issues.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* 3\+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability, or Cloud infrastructure roles.
* Strong knowledge of both Azure and AWS is a must.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps).
* Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes).
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation).
* Strong scripting skills (Bash, Python, or PowerShell).
* Experience with Git and version control workflows.
* Understanding of networking, security, and Linux system administration.
* Mandatory working knowledge of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, etc.) for day\-to\-day work.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills.

**Good to Have**

* Certifications in AWS/Azure (Associate or Professional level).
* Experience with monitoring/observability stacks (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog).
* Knowledge of serverless architecture (Lambda, Azure Functions).
* Experience with configuration management tools (Chef, Puppet, SaltStack).
* Familiarity with security best practices (DevSecOps) and compliance requirements.

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹700,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Azure DevOps Senior Technical Specialist
description:
Azure DevOps Senior Technical Specialist
Ahmadabad City, Gujarat
**Job Summary**
---------------


The Senior Technical Specialist in DevOps Solutions,Azure DevOps will be responsible for overseeing and implementing Azure DevOps solutions within the organization. They will play a key role in optimizing the software development lifecycle through automation and collaboration, ensuring efficient delivery of high\-quality software products.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


1\. Designing, deploying, and maintaining azure devops pipelines to automate build, test, and deployment processes.
  

2\. Collaborating with development and operations teams to implement ci/cd best practices.
  

3\. Monitoring and optimizing azure cloud infrastructure to ensure scalability, availability, and performance.
  

4\. Troubleshooting and resolving issues related to azure devops tools and services.
  

5\. Implementing security measures in azure devops pipelines to protect sensitive data.
  

6\. Providing technical guidance and support to team members on azure devops tools and practices.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Proficiency in azure cloud services and azure devops tools.
  

2\. Strong experience with ci/cd pipelines, version control systems, and automation tools.
  

3\. Knowledge of infrastructure as code (iac) using tools like terraform or arm templates.
  

4\. Ability to script and automate tasks using powershell, bash, or python.
  

5\. Familiarity with containerization technologies such as docker and kubernetes.
  

6\. Excellent problem\-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and addressing technical issues.
  

7\. Strong communication and teamwork abilities to collaborate effectively with cross functional teams.
**Other Requirements**
----------------------


1\.Microsoft Certified1\.Azure DevOps Engineer Expert certification preferred.
